nodes.label: Spoken Response Policy
nodes.rationale: Code default is 200 normalized characters before falling back to the chat-panel prompt, but docs/setup_guide.md documents a 50-character threshold — an unresolved documentation/code mismatch flagged as an open product decision (FRD gap #1, NFR/FR-VOICE-016).

nodes.label: Main Process Concentration Risk
nodes.rationale: apps/desktop/src/main/main.ts exceeds 2,200 lines and owns setup, voice, research, media, landing-page, and agent-birth workflows; recommendation is to decompose into smaller runtime modules before adding more capabilities.

nodes.label: Renderer/Core Contract Duplication
nodes.rationale: apps/desktop/src/renderer/global.d.ts duplicates contracts from packages/core/src/shared/types.ts and voice/setup modules, creating drift risk; recommendation is to export renderer-safe API types from a shared module.

nodes.label: Regex-Based Routing Ambiguity Risk
nodes.rationale: Intent routing is regex-based, so research follow-ups can intercept ordinary chat and landing-page revision prompts can misclassify broad edit-like language; recommendation is to add route diagnostics and a structured route result debug view.

nodes.label: reaserch-agent ID Misspelling
nodes.rationale: The seeded agent ID and name 'reaserch-agent'/'Reaserch Agent' are misspelled in source; treated as the current persisted contract unless migrated. FRD flags deciding on ID/name migration as an open product decision.

nodes.label: Electron Renderer Sandbox Disabled
nodes.rationale: Electron renderer sandbox is set to false even though context isolation is enabled and Node integration is disabled; NFR-SEC-006 flags this as a gap that should be enabled or consciously risk-accepted before broader distribution.

nodes.label: MVP Local-Only Packaging Decision
nodes.rationale: Developer ID signing, hardened runtime, and notarization are intentionally out of scope for this pass; the DMG/ZIP build is a local/internal package only, not hardened for external macOS distribution.
